---------------------------------------

The Manager – Sourcing & Procurement (Leather & Luggage) will be responsible for sourcing and procurement of leather, fabrics, trims, hardware, and related materials used in the manufacture of leather bags, wallets, belts, luggage, travel accessories, and small leather goods (SLG). The role will ensure material availability, cost competitiveness, quality compliance, supplier development, inventory optimization, and support for product development and production requirements. The incumbent will work closely with Product Development, Merchandising, Production, Quality, Stores, and Finance teams to ensure efficient procurement operations.

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **1. Strategic Sourcing & Procurement**

* Source leather and accessory materials including cow, goat, buffalo and sheep leather, finished and semi-finished leather, vegetable-tanned and chrome-tanned leather.
* Procure fabrics, linings, webbings, zippers, locks, buckles, handles, trolleys, wheels, fittings, and packaging materials.
* Develop sourcing strategies aligned with quality, cost, and business requirements.
* Ensure timely procurement for sampling, development, and bulk production.
* Build reliable domestic and international supplier networks and identify alternate sourcing options.

#### **2. Vendor Development & Management**

* Identify, evaluate, onboard, and develop suppliers, tanneries, and component manufacturers.
* Build strong supplier relationships to ensure quality, cost efficiency, innovation, and delivery reliability.
* Conduct supplier assessments covering quality, commercial competitiveness, capacity, compliance, and delivery performance.
* Drive supplier improvement initiatives and corrective action plans.

#### **3. Commercial Negotiation & Cost Management**

* Lead negotiations on pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, contracts, and commercial agreements.
* Monitor leather and raw material market trends.
* Drive cost reduction, value engineering, and procurement optimization initiatives.
* Prepare supplier comparison analyses and procurement reports.
* Manage procurement budgets and cost-effective purchasing practices.

#### **4. Quality & Compliance Management**

* Coordinate with Product Development and Quality teams to ensure materials meet specifications.
* Monitor quality parameters including thickness, GSM, grain, texture, colour consistency, finish, softness, durability, and defect rates.
* Resolve supplier quality issues and material rejections.
* Ensure compliance with quality, environmental, and sustainability standards.

#### **5. Inventory & Material Planning**

* Collaborate with Production Planning and Stores teams to forecast material requirements.
* Maintain optimal inventory levels while minimizing excess and obsolete stock.
* Monitor stock movement, consumption patterns, and replenishment cycles.
* Ensure uninterrupted material availability for production and shipment commitments.

#### **6. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Coordinate with Product Development, Merchandising, Sampling, Design, Production, Quality, Stores, Logistics, Finance, and Accounts teams.
* Provide updates on material availability, procurement status, shortages, and supplier performance.
* Participate in production planning, sourcing reviews, and business planning meetings.

#### **7. Documentation & Governance**

* Maintain purchase orders, supplier agreements, contracts, invoices, delivery records, and inventory documentation.
* Manage procurement data through ERP systems.
* Support audits and compliance requirements.
* Ensure adherence to procurement policies, ethical sourcing practices, and governance standards.

---------------------------

* Graduate/Post-graduate in any discipline.
* Preferred:
* + Degree/Diploma in Leather Technology, Materials Management, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, or related fields.
  + Professional certification in Procurement or Supply Chain Management will be an added advantage.

----------------------

* 8-15 years of relevant experience in sourcing and procurement within:
* + Leather Bags

  + Fashion Accessories

title: Staff Database Reliability Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

**Staff Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) - Data Platform**

**OpenSearch Must-Have | Distributed Systems | Kafka | Redis | Capacity Engineering | Automation**

**Level**

Staff DBRE (Senior Individual Contributor / Technical Lead)

**Domain**

Distributed Data Platforms

**Primary Focus**

Cross-team architecture and systemic reliability for OpenSearch-centered data platforms, with Kafka, Redis, capacity engineering, and Python automation

**Work Expectations**

U.S. Eastern Time business hours; on-call participation as required

**1. Role Summary**
===================

We are seeking an experienced Staff DBRE with deep OpenSearch/Elasticsearch expertise and strong distributed-systems judgment. The role leads high-impact architecture, reliability, performance, scalability, capacity, and lifecycle improvements across major data-platform services, complemented by Kafka, Redis, Linux, observability, and Python automation.

The Staff DBRE solves ambiguous cross-team problems, establishes reusable platform patterns, mentors senior engineers, and influences multiple engineering groups. The scope extends beyond a single cluster or incident while remaining hands-on and evidence-driven.

**2. Level Scope and Leadership Expectations**
==============================================

Staff DBRE is a senior individual-contributor technical leadership role focused on solving ambiguous, high-impact reliability and architecture problems across platforms and teams. The role has broad influence within the data-platform domain, while enterprise-wide cross-domain strategy remains a Principal-level responsibility.

**Dimension**

**Expectation at This Level**

**Scope of Ownership**

Owns complex cross-team reliability, scalability, performance, capacity, architecture, and operational-maturity problems across major OpenSearch-centered platform services.

**Technical Depth**

Serves as a domain authority in OpenSearch and distributed-systems failure modes, with strong supporting depth in Kafka, Redis, JVM, Linux, storage, and networking.

**Engineering Leadership**

Defines platform-domain patterns, mentors Senior and Lead engineers, raises design-review and incident-analysis rigor, and influences adjacent teams.

**Automation Architecture**

Designs reusable Python automation, observability, validation, and lifecycle-management patterns rather than isolated scripts.

**Execution**

Drives ambiguous initiatives from problem framing through design, alignment, implementation guidance, and measurable outcomes.

**Organizational Influence**

Influences multiple engineering groups through data, production evidence, design standards, and technical judgment; does not unilaterally set enterprise strategy.

**3. Key Responsibilities**
===========================

**A. OpenSearch Platform Architecture**
---------------------------------------

* Design and improve large-scale OpenSearch/Elasticsearch topology, dedicated node roles, shard and index strategies, lifecycle management, workload distribution, and recovery patterns.
* Solve complex indexing, search, cluster-state, JVM/GC, storage, segment, mapping, allocation, and cross-cluster reliability problems.
* Establish domain-level resilience, snapshot, replication, upgrade, and capacity patterns appropriate to the actual scale of the environment.

**B. Kafka and Redis Reliability**
----------------------------------

* Guide Kafka topology, partitioning, replication, capacity, consumer reliability, and failure-mode remediation for critical services.
* Guide Redis Cluster and Sentinel architecture, memory and eviction behavior, persistence tradeoffs, failover, re-sharding, and client reliability.

**C. Automation, Observability, and Capacity Engineering**
----------------------------------------------------------

* Architect reusable Python tooling and safe remediation frameworks for provisioning, validation, maintenance, scaling, and incident prevention.
* Define domain-level observability, SLIs/SLOs, capacity models, lifecycle forecasts, and actionable risk thresholds.
* Establish Infrastructure-as-Code and operator patterns where they improve repeatability and supportability.

**D. Technical Strategy and Cross-Team Leadership**
---------------------------------------------------

* Lead architecture and production-readiness reviews for the data-platform domain.
* Evaluate emerging technologies through workload-relevant benchmarks, failure testing, operability reviews, and total-cost considerations.
* Lead complex technical investigations and systemic corrective actions; mentor engineers and improve engineering practices across teams.

**4. Required Qualifications and Experience**
=============================================

* 8+ years of DBRE, SRE, database, or distributed data-platform engineering experience with Staff, Lead, or comparable technical leadership scope.
* Deep hands-on mastery of OpenSearch and/or Elasticsearch internals, operations, performance, lifecycle management, recovery, and architecture.
* Strong production experience with Kafka and/or Redis, with the ability to reason across distributed data-platform failure modes.
* Strong systems expertise across JVM, Linux, CPU, memory, storage I/O, networking, and capacity behavior.
* Strong Python software-engineering capability for reusable production automation and tooling.
* Demonstrated success solving ambiguous cross-team technical problems and influencing architecture through evidence and judgment.
* Strong incident leadership, written communication, mentoring, and design-review skills.

**5. Preferred Qualifications**
===============================

* Experience with both Kafka and Redis at meaningful production scale.
* Kubernetes operators, Terraform, Ansible, GitOps, and cloud-managed data services.
* Experience evaluating ClickHouse, Pinot, vector databases, or stream-processing technologies.
* Experience with chaos testing, production-readiness reviews, and cost-aware capacity engineering.

**6. Expected Outcomes in the First 6-12 Months**
=================================================

* Establish measurable reliability, capacity, lifecycle, and operational-maturity baselines for critical data-platform services and lead material improvements.
* Deliver reusable automation and observability patterns that reduce systemic toil and improve safe execution across teams.
* Publish and drive adoption of domain-level architecture, production-readiness, capacity, and resilience standards.
* Resolve one or more high-impact systemic risks and develop a prioritized multi-quarter improvement roadmap for the data-platform domain.

**7. What This Role Does Not Include**
======================================

* This is not a people-management role unless separately assigned; leadership is exercised through technical influence and mentorship.
* This is not a coordination-only role; the Staff DBRE must remain hands-on and capable of deep technical investigation.
* This role does not replace ownership held by application, SRE, infrastructure, network, storage, or cloud teams.
* This is not a ticket-queue role limited to incident response and routine operations; systemic improvement is expected.
* This role does not unilaterally define enterprise-wide cross-domain architecture or approval policy; that scope belongs to Principal-level and executive governance.

**8. Work Expectations and Location**
=====================================

This role requires working during U.S. Eastern Time (ET) business hours and participating in on-call support as required.

title: Director,DBRE
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

**The Opportunity**
===================

Qualys runs one of the largest and most complex data platforms in the enterprise security industry — a massive Oracle and Exadata estate at the core, surrounded by a self-managed open-source big data fabric: Kafka, Hadoop, Cassandra, OpenSearch, Redis, Ceph, and Kubernetes. These systems directly underpin the product SLAs we deliver to 10,000+ customers worldwide.

We are looking for a Director of Database Reliability Engineering who combines deep technical craft with the leadership instinct to scale a team and the builder's mindset to ship systems that eliminate toil. You don't have to be the world's leading expert in every technology on the stack — but you must carry genuine depth in Oracle or large-scale distributed data systems, with strong working knowledge across the broader ecosystem, and the intellectual range to go deep where the situation demands it. We do not expect day-one mastery across every system; we expect depth in core areas and the proven ability to rapidly develop expertise where the platform needs it.

This role directly owns database platform operations and reliability practices, and influences adjacent infrastructure and application teams through technical credibility and cross-functional partnership. You will lead a team of ~30, serve as the final technical escalation point for the data platform, and shape the multi-year strategy for how Qualys builds, automates, and evolves its data infrastructure.

**Core Focus Areas**
====================

This is a wide-scope role. Here is how candidates should prioritize their self-evaluation:

**01** **Oracle + Distributed Systems Technical Depth** — Deep in one, strong across the other — enough to lead architecture and hold the team accountable

**02** **Data Platform Reliability & Incident Ownership** — SLOs, escalation authority, DR, predictive capacity — the foundational mandate

**03** **AI-Driven Automation & Toil Elimination** — Building and shipping agents, not just evaluating tools — measurable impact on MTTR and operational load

**04** **Team Leadership & Org Development** — Managing ~30 across ICs and managers; building culture, career ladders, and hiring bar

**05** **Vendor Management & Cost Optimization** — Oracle relationship, licensing discipline, and infrastructure cost efficiency

**What Makes This Role Unique**
===============================

* **Breadth of scope, depth of ownership** — You hold the charter for Oracle/Exadata AND the full open-source big data stack — accountable for reliability across all of it
* **Build AI systems, not just use them** — We expect shipped production tooling — AI agents, autonomous remediation, intelligent observability — not proof-of-concept demos
* **Strategy and execution in equal measure** — You will define the multi-year data platform roadmap and then make it happen — this is not a pure operations role
* **Real cross-functional influence** — Data reliability touches every product team; this role earns authority through technical credibility, not org chart position
* **A platform worth modernizing** — Battle-tested at scale, with genuine complexity — and a leadership team committed to doing it right

**What You Will Build**
=======================

Beyond running the platform, we expect this leader to leave a concrete engineering footprint. Examples of the systems we want this role to build and own:

* **AI-assisted incident triage system** — LLM-powered log analysis and alert summarization that cuts triage time from minutes to seconds
* **Autonomous remediation agents** — Self-healing workflows for common failure patterns — space exhaustion, replication lag, lock contention, consumer group lag — with safe human escalation fallback
* **Natural-language operational query interface** — Engineers ask questions in plain English; the system queries metrics, logs, and configuration state to answer
* **Predictive capacity and anomaly models** — ML-driven forecasting for Oracle tablespace growth, Kafka partition pressure, and Cassandra compaction backlog
* **Reliability-as-code pipeline gates** — Automated schema review, load test, and regression detection integrated into CI/CD so reliability issues are caught before production

**What You Will Do**
====================

**Own the Data Platform Reliability Charter**
---------------------------------------------

* Define and drive SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets across Oracle, Exadata, Kafka, Cassandra, Hadoop, OpenSearch, Redis, Ceph, and Kubernetes-hosted data services
* Serve as the final technical escalation point for all P0/P1 incidents; lead blameless post-incident reviews and drive permanent resolution — not workarounds
* Own disaster recovery architecture, backup integrity standards, and data durability SLAs — validated through regular DR exercises
* Establish predictive capacity planning and performance baselines across the full data platform footprint
* Drive cost efficiency and infrastructure utilization optimization — right-sizing resources, eliminating idle capacity, and building chargeback/showback visibility for leadership

**Define and Execute the Multi-Year Data Platform Strategy**
------------------------------------------------------------

* Develop and own a multi-year DBRE roadmap — covering reliability targets, modernization priorities, platform consolidation opportunities, and AI automation milestones
* Drive platform evolution decisions: when to standardize, when to consolidate, when to retire, and when to invest in new capabilities
* Provide architectural guidance for major data platform initiatives — schema design, topology changes, new technology adoption, and migration planning
* Partner with Product Engineering, Security, and Infrastructure leadership to embed reliability and cost constraints into platform direction from day one

**Go Deep on Oracle and Exadata**
---------------------------------

* Carry deep technical authority for Oracle Database (19c+), RAC, Data Guard, RMAN, and Exadata — sufficient to lead architecture reviews, diagnose production incidents, and hold senior engineers accountable
* Drive query optimization, AWR/ASH-based diagnostics, execution plan analysis, and schema design reviews for mission-critical OLTP and analytical workloads
* Manage Oracle vendor relationships with technical and commercial depth: negotiate support contracts, challenge licensing interpretations, escalate through Oracle's senior channels, and ensure Qualys negotiates from a position of knowledge
* Own Oracle licensing compliance end-to-end — a material financial and risk area requiring both engineering precision and commercial acumen
* Lead Exadata patching cadence, storage cell failure playbooks, IORM policy tuning, and hardware lifecycle planning

**Lead the Open-Source Big Data Platform**
------------------------------------------

* Architect and operate Kafka, Cassandra, Hadoop, OpenSearch, Redis, and Ceph deployments — self-managed at scale, not cloud-managed services
* Apply strong distributed systems fundamentals — consensus and replication models, storage I/O patterns, network latency sensitivity, and horizontal scaling — to architectural decisions that hold under load
* Partner with DevOps and Platform Engineering on Kubernetes-native stateful workloads: operators, persistent volumes, storage class optimization, and capacity planning
* Drive standardization of runbooks, alerting, and operational playbooks across all technologies — documented, automated, no tribal knowledge

**Build AI-Powered Reliability Systems**
----------------------------------------

* Design and ship AI agents that automate tier-1 database operational toil — systems running in production with measurable impact on MTTR and alert noise
* Integrate LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini) into operational workflows for log triage, incident summarization, runbook execution, and anomaly-triggered decision support
* Evaluate AIOps platforms and observability tooling with engineering rigor — quantify the actual value, not the vendor pitch
* Embed reliability-by-design upstream: schema review gates, load test automation, and database performance regression detection in CI/CD pipelines

**Lead and Develop the DBRE Team**
----------------------------------

* Manage, mentor, and develop ~30 DBAs, SREs, and data platform engineers across individual contributors and engineering managers
* Define hiring standards, career ladders, and team structure that attract and retain senior database and reliability talent
* Build a culture of technical rigor, blameless learning, and relentless automation — where manual toil is a bug, not a process
* Eliminate single points of knowledge failure through documentation, cross-training, and disciplined on-call rotation design
* Own workforce planning: headcount forecasting, skills gap analysis, and building specialist sub-teams as the platform evolves

**How We Measure Success**
==========================

* **Platform Availability** — SLO attainment across all data services — reduction in unplanned production incidents attributable to DBRE gaps
* **MTTA / MTTR** — Measurable improvement in time to detect and resolve incidents, accelerated by AI tooling
* **Automation Coverage** — Percentage of tier-1 operational tasks eliminated through shipped agents and tooling
* **Cost Efficiency** — Infrastructure utilization rates, Oracle licensing optimization, and idle/over-provisioned resource reduction
* **Team Health & Retention** — On-call load reduction, career growth trajectory, and senior IC/manager retention
* **Platform Strategy Execution** — Multi-year roadmap milestones delivered; capacity forecasts validated against actual growth

**What We Are Looking For**
===========================

**Must Have**
-------------

* 15+ years in database engineering, reliability engineering, or data platform operations — with 5+ years leading multi-person teams including at least one layer of managers
* Deep expertise in Oracle or large-scale distributed data systems, with strong working knowledge across the broader ecosystem (Kafka, Cassandra, Hadoop, OpenSearch, Redis, Ceph, Kubernetes)
* Strong distributed systems fundamentals — replication and consensus models, storage I/O, network latency tradeoffs, and scaling patterns for stateful workloads — applied to real production decisions
* Shipped operational tooling or agents using LLM APIs with measurable impact (MTTR reduction, toil elimination, alert noise reduction) — production systems, not proofs of concept
* Oracle vendor relationship management — commercial negotiation, license compliance ownership, and technical escalation through Oracle's support and sales organizations
* Infrastructure cost control — hands-on experience right-sizing compute and storage, eliminating idle capacity, and building cost visibility (chargeback/showback) across database infrastructure
* Track record leading teams of 15+ engineers with both IC and manager-level reports; experience growing technical talent and building hiring bars
* Executive communication skills — translating database risk, reliability posture, and investment needs to C-suite audiences with clarity and commercial grounding
* Experience serving as final escalation point for production data platform incidents — with the technical depth to diagnose, direct, and close

The **L2 Application Support Engineer** (Technical Support Analyst) is a critical role within the Production Support and Operations team. This individual is responsible for providing high-quality technical support, troubleshooting, and incident resolution for complex enterprise applications and platforms. Acting as the bridge between L1 Helpdesk/Monitoring teams and L3 Development/Engineering groups, the L2 Engineer ensures system availability, stability, and adherence to strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs) in a fast-paced, enterprise technology environment.

* **Escalation Handling:** Acknowledge and own incidents escalated by the L1 support team or monitoring alerts.
* **Troubleshooting & Diagnosis:** Perform in-depth technical analysis and root cause investigation of application, database, middleware, and infrastructure failures.

* **Collaboration:** Partner with L3 developers, database administrators (DBAs), network engineers, and system administrators to resolve complex, multi-tiered issues.
* **Incident Lifecycle Management:** Track and document all incident progression within the ITSM platform (e.g., ServiceNow) from creation through to resolution.
  

  

**2. Monitoring, Observability & Preventive Maintenance**

* **System Monitoring:** Actively monitor application health, batch jobs, integration feeds, and system performance using enterprise observability suites.

* **Health Checks:** Perform daily health checks, start-of-day (SOD) and end-of-day (EOD) verifications, and batch processing runs.

**3. Release, Deployment & Configuration Management**

* **Deployment Validation:** Support the verification of application deployments, system patches, and infrastructure upgrades during maintenance windows.

**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. **Title and Summary**


Senior Service Management Engineer
Service Management Engineer  

Mastercard is seeking a Service Management Engineer to help ensure the stability, resilience, and operational excellence of critical payment, clearing, data, and platform services. This role operates at the intersection of technology, operations, risk, change, incident management, and customer engagement, helping teams deliver reliable services while continuously improving production readiness and customer experience.  

The Service Management Engineer acts as a production readiness steward and service owner, partnering with product, engineering, operations, risk, and customer\-facing teams to proactively manage service health, operational risk, change readiness, incident response, problem resolution, certificate lifecycle management, and continual service improvement across complex, distributed environments.  

Role Purpose  

* Ensure supported platforms and services are stable, resilient, compliant, and ready for production use.
* Drive operational excellence by embedding service management, ITSM, risk, resiliency, automation, monitoring, and change governance practices across the service lifecycle.
* Act as a bridge between product, engineering, operations, customer support, risk, and customer stakeholders to align customer priorities with operational needs.
* Promote developer\-run ownership and help engineering teams design, build, and operate fault\-tolerant, scalable, and supportable services.


Key Responsibilities  

* Service Ownership and Production Readiness: Maintain strong technical and operational knowledge of supported services, ensure readiness before go\-live, and drive adoption of operational standards for reliability, scalability, monitoring, capacity, and supportability.
* Incident and Problem Management: Lead or support triage, escalation, root cause analysis, post\-incident reviews, and long\-term corrective actions. Identify incident trends, ask the right questions to uncover true root cause, and drive improvements that reduce recurrence and improve service stability.
* Change and Release Governance: Review service changes for readiness, impact, risk, timing, customer communication, and execution quality. Partner with engineering, delivery, and product teams to ensure changes are properly assessed, approved, tested, communicated, and executed with minimal customer impact.
* Certificate Lifecycle Management: Act as a key contact for certificate renewal detection, tracking, consultation, automation assessment, and timely remediation to prevent certificate\-related service disruption.
* Risk, Controls, and Compliance: Partner with program teams and risk stakeholders to ensure operational, security, and compliance standards are followed. Maintain visibility of service risks, mitigation plans, control gaps, and remediation progress.
* Service Performance and Continuous Improvement: Monitor service health, KPIs, SLAs, ticket trends, customer feedback, and recurring operational pain points. Translate insights into service improvement plans that strengthen resilience and customer experience.
* Stakeholder and Customer Engagement: Build trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders, communicate clearly during critical events, manage escalations, and represent customer priorities to backend engineering and operations teams.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work across geographically distributed teams, influence without direct authority, and provide operational context to engineers, architects, product owners, support teams, and leadership.


All About You  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 6–8\+ years of experience in IT service management, production support, site reliability engineering, business operations, technology service management, or a related role.
* Strong understanding of ITSM lifecycle practices, including incident, problem, change, release, service readiness, risk, and continual improvement. ITIL certification is preferred.
* Experience working in mission\-critical production environments with high availability, customer impact sensitivity, and strong operational governance expectations.
* Proven ability to lead incident response, root cause analysis, post\-incident reviews, service improvement discussions, and customer or leadership communications during critical events.
* Ability to analyze ticket trends, service metrics, monitoring alerts, risks, and operational data to identify patterns and drive measurable improvements.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics clearly to working\-level, senior\-level, and customer audiences.
* Comfortable working across matrixed, diverse, and geographically distributed teams, with the ability to influence outcomes without direct authority.
* Systematic problem\-solving mindset, strong sense of ownership, and ability to balance urgent restoration with long\-term service health.


Preferred Skills and Experience  

* Experience with clearing, payments, real\-time transaction processing, managed services, or regulated financial technology environments.
* Hands\-on experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, or similar platforms.
* Mainframe experience is preferred.
* Experience with cryptography, certificate lifecycle management, renewal automation, and related security controls.
* Working knowledge of relational databases such as Oracle or PostgreSQL, including SQL, PL/SQL, query analysis, and performance considerations.
* Familiarity with CI/CD tools and engineering practices, including Git or Bitbucket, Jenkins, Maven, Artifactory, Groovy, Chef, and automated deployment pipelines.
* Interest in automation, operational tooling, resiliency engineering, capacity planning, and troubleshooting large\-scale distributed systems.
* Pragmatic, detail\-oriented, and growth\-minded approach, with flexibility to support critical changes, escalations, and time\-zone aligned operational needs when required.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
